entities.title: Merging to main deploys the game
entities.summary: The Deploy workflow tests, builds and uploads the game whenever its folder changes on main.
steps: npm test (the Worker), npm run test:godot (maps and the message layer)
npm run build: Godot 4.7.2 web export, the engine split in parts, boot.js
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/double-cross/.
entities.deployedBy: The Deploy workflow on every push to main that changes games/double-cross outside its .dev folders; by hand with Run workflow; or `npm run deploy` with a Cloudflare token.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded. The Deploy workflow deploys only from main, so going back means merging a revert, which deploys it. There is no database to undo.
